name: Nak's Skull
summary: Nak's Skull carries weight in the southern Barrens, where Razormane raids trouble the Horde. At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth seeks vengeance on the kin who left him to die.

sections.title: A Token of Vengeance
sections.body:
Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane lead raids from Razorfen Kraul across the Barrens. Their warbands strike Horde settlements and roads, while Crossroads defenders know nothing of plans beyond ordinary tribal skirmishing.

At Camp Taurajo, the captive Razormane Mangletooth was left to die in a cage by his own people. He now seeks revenge on those former brethren. He demands Nak's, Kuz's, and Lok Orcbane's severed skulls as proof they are dead, delivered by Horde adventurers. With that proof, he means to break the southern raiding parties.

faq.answer: Nak is a Razormane quilboar commander who leads raids alongside Kuz and Lok Orcbane. The three came from Razorfen Kraul and strike Horde travelers and settlements across the southern Barrens.

aliases: who do i give naks skull to
faq.answer: Mangletooth, a captive Razormane quilboar at Camp Taurajo, wants Nak's Skull. His own kin abandoned him, and he seeks revenge on the leaders who betrayed him.

faq.q: Why does Mangletooth want the skulls of his own people?
faq.answer: Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane left Mangletooth to die in captivity. He helps the Horde find them and demands their severed heads as proof they are dead.

faq.q: Does collecting Nak's Skull help protect the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Yes. Mangletooth says Nak and his partners direct Razormane raids against the Crossroads and the central trade routes. Their defeat weakens the tribe's coordinated attacks.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can ease pressure on supply lines between Camp Taurajo and the Crossroads by taking the heads of Razormane warlords like Nak.
